_about: Facts about Brian for the machine's archive, beyond the resume. src/data/corpus.md is written from this file, the two resumes and the projects page, and scripts/gen-corpus.cjs checks every number in the archive against all of them. This file is PUBLIC (it ships in the repo): only what Brian is happy for anyone to read. Nothing from autoapply's private fields - no birth date, phone, address, demographics, health, test scores or pay.

_sources.transcript: Brian's unofficial transcript (Howdy copy, 23 Nov 2026): course codes, titles and terms only. Grades per course, the student ID and every other identifier are left out; the GPA is the resume's 3.87/4.00.
